limits: Same-corpus method development after prior BCE and categorical observations, not independent confirmation.
Three model seeds share one source corpus and fixed query sets.
Document-arrival phases are an authored curriculum, not production history.
This tests evidence addressing and source reads; all raw source content is retained and no parametric content-compression benefit is claimed.
Literal module names are explicitly present in this task; unrestricted language/entity resolution is not tested.
Top1 twice and top2 use the same frozen scores and equal two-read budget; equality verifies execution/accounting, not a distinct learned-planning advantage.
